description: Optional CGS hooks; review and trust through the client. Explicit CLI fallback works without native activation.

hooks.command: node -e "const f=require('node:fs'),p=require('node:path'),c=require('node:child_process');let r=process.cwd();while(!f.existsSync(p.join(r,'scripts/codex/hooks.mjs'))){const n=p.dirname(r);if(n===r)throw Error('CGS hook adapter not found');r=n}const x=c.spawnSync(process.execPath,[p.join(r,'scripts/codex/hooks.mjs'),'SessionStart'],{stdio:'inherit'});process.exit(x.status===null?2:x.status)"
